issues: Dolphin body is rendered as a fragmented, dithered point-cloud/scatter rather than a clean continuous lit-phosphor silhouette; edges are jagged and the form reads as noise, not a graceful creature

Eliminate internal body noise/fog; fill the body uniformly so it reads as a single lit phosphor object
Reduce bloom intensity on the body so cores are bright cyan (not white) and edges stay crisp with only a soft halo
Sharpen and clearly shape the dorsal fin, pectoral fin, and tail fluke so the silhouette is unmistakable
Make the water lines thinner, flatter, and lower contrast (2 subtle rows) so they stay subordinate
Trim or dim the bottom-right text cluster so the FFT bar graph remains the quiet bottom element
Implement a true short-decay persistence buffer so moving parts leave a clean 2-3 frame trail rather than whole-body scatter
